name: ClickUp
description: Find your ClickUp tasks in a sidebar panel and start an Orca worktree, and optionally an agent, from a task.

settings.title: Status after worktree start
settings.description: The plugin sets the task to this ClickUp status after it creates a worktree, for example "in progress". Keep it empty to not change the status.

settings.title: Agent prompt
settings.description: The first prompt for the agent. Placeholders: {id}, {name}, {url}, {status}, {list} and {description}. Keep it empty to use the default prompt.

settings.title: Orca CLI path
settings.description: The path of the orca command. Keep it empty to use the Orca app bundle or the orca command on PATH.
